name: vstack
description: Visual Stack — visual-first delivery for Claude Code: plan, design, and build software on artifacts you operate, not documents you read. Skills are invoked as /vstack:<skill>. Currently: go (from any conversation, work out where the stack can pick up and help), start (set up a project on a multi-step visual form — from the Cavalry template, as a specs-and-design-only workspace, or by recording an existing codebase), wireframe (build a UI wireframe and comment directly on it), spec (a drill-down spec tree the user prunes and annotates, exported as plain markdown), user-story-map (plan releases on an interactive drag-and-drop story map), phase-wireframe (see a signed-off wireframe at each release phase), and phase-build (plan a phase on a visual board, then watch it build with live per-node progress). The interactive ones link the open page back to the Claude session, so edits and feedback return without copy-paste. Tool-agnostic: plain files in and out, nothing owned, safe beside speckit or any other tooling.
